versions.changelog: Fix order execution docs (no app-side confirmation), add ClawHub badge to README, correct security notes about immediate execution

Robinhood Agentic Trading skill initial release.

- Connects OpenClaw to Robinhood Agentic Trading via MCP for automated portfolio management and trading.
- Supports OAuth 2.1 PKCE authentication with secure local token storage.
- Provides commands to view portfolio, analyze positions, place/cancel trades, and access real-time quotes.
- Includes automatic token refresh and clear separation between read-only and trading tools.
- Comprehensive setup, usage instructions, and security best practices documented.
